verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: The version-consistent publication and permission-aware query contract is exceptionally complete: all three write targets, same-version publication gate, unavailable repair/rollback path, parallel hybrid retrieval, permission filtering, grounded citation generation, and low-confidence abstention are explicitly connected.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: R5: extraction is shown, but the required normalization of heterogeneous source formats is not explicitly represented.
verdict.coverage_summary: Thirty-eight of thirty-nine atomic requirements are fully represented. The sole partial requirement is explicit format normalization during extraction; no requirement is absent or contradicted, so no cap applies. Weighted coverage is 69/70 = 0.9857.
